name: 港风校园百搭格纹衬衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，完整呈现格纹与版型
代入校园通勤穿搭生活，展示上身比例与松弛感
用背面视角证明落肩宽松的剪裁与面料垂感
放大普通合身衬衫抬手紧绷的问题，反衬落肩松弛版型
shots.textZone: one short label above each panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 微距呈现格纹对位与织面质感，证明面料做工
特写领口与门襟工艺，回应细节控疑虑
shots.textZone: one short label beside the collar reading 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 平铺展示整衣轮廓并给出空白尺码表位，消除选码疑虑
shots.textZone: spec table headers as 「{callout_4}」 and blank value cells, dimension labels 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 并列多配色格纹，帮助买家快速选色
shots.textZone: one color-name chip under each variant reading 「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 用车缝与包边细节加空证明位，降低质感疑虑
shots.textZone: lower right band with blank proof placeholder labelled 「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 高对比收口，用行动按钮完成转化
shots.textZone: CTA bar reading 「{callout_8}」 and a short headline 「{selling_point_2}」

style.backgroundSystem: parchment cream #F6F1E6 and deep parchment #E9E2D4 flat boards for packshot and flat-lay screens, deep slate blue #52708F fields for display and street screens, one full-bleed terracotta #C06A3B field reserved for the closing screen
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single terracotta #C06A3B stroke
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight from the upper left, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5200K neutral white balance
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent campus-street menswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of parchment cream #F6F1E6, deep slate blue #52708F, ink charcoal #2A3038 and one terracotta accent #C06A3B; soft diffused daylight from the upper left with gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; clean high-end fashion photography mixed with minimal thin-line infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and garment scale across the set, collar and placket always squared
style.surfaceSystem: matte parchment board #E9E2D4 and smooth concrete-grey pavement for street shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headlines in ink charcoal #2A3038, accent labels in terracotta #C06A3B
